spec:
Change the execute-zzzops skill (and `next` action rendering if needed) so root hands a worker only the action's `start` command and its minted label; the worker runs `start`, reads its own card, prompt and inputs, and returns a short outcome or blocked question. Root keeps human interaction and op nodes. Acceptance: in a real harness transcript, root never reads a worker node's prompt or input blobs, and independence and lease handling still hold. Old wording relied on policy receipts, model-effort binding and worker reuse that no longer exist.

Migrated from GitHub issue #481 after the engine reset (#740).
title: Let workers claim their own task cards so root context stays small
